audit_metadata.diagnostic_cohort: 2023-01-03 to 2024-12-31 (484 trading days, 197 securities, 85,981 daily bars)

turn_1_initial_state_probe.diagnosis: The 20-day momentum factor failed the admission policy. The Rank IC is significantly negative across all forward return horizons with HAC robust t-statistic < -2.80 on 1D and 5D.

turn_2_microstructure_reflection.reflection_title: Empirical Microstructure Analysis of Momentum Invalidation in China A-Shares

mathematical_financial_findings.mechanism: Retail investors represent over 60% of daily trading volume in A-shares. They exhibit strong disposition effect and lottery preferences, aggressively chasing stocks breaking out over a 20-day trailing window. This rapid liquidity influx drives prices above intrinsic equilibrium. Once short-term buying momentum fades, smart institutional money sells into the liquidity, precipitating severe downward price mean-reversion (short-term reversal anomaly STREV).

mathematical_financial_findings.dimension: T+1 Trading Rules and Asymmetric Liquidity Lock
mathematical_financial_findings.mechanism: Under the A-share T+1 settlement mechanism, shares purchased cannot be liquidated on the same trading day. Retail breakout traders who chase momentum near daily price limits (+10%/+20%) are locked into overnight inventory risk. When morning openings next day fail to follow through, trapped momentum capital causes cascaded liquidation, amplifying negative 1D/5D forward IC.

mathematical_financial_findings.dimension: Turnover Anomaly and Speculative Churn Penalty
mathematical_financial_findings.mechanism: Stocks experiencing high 20-day momentum are almost always characterized by abnormally elevated turnover rates. In A-shares, turnover rate is negatively correlated with future excess returns (the 'Turnover Anomaly'). Chasing high momentum inherently purchases high-turnover lottery stocks that suffer substantial trading friction and structural alpha decay.

In 2023-2024, the A-share market was dominated by rapid thematic rotation across AI/TMT, State-Owned Enterprises (Zhong-Te-Gu), High Dividend Yield, and Micro-caps. Raw price momentum without industry neutralization is essentially an unhedged bet on the sector that rallied over the past month. When the rotation shifts, un-neutralized momentum suffers catastrophic factor drawdowns.

In academic literature (e.g. Jegadeesh & Titman 1993), 12-month momentum is positive in developed markets, but 1-month return is universally recognized as a reversal factor. In A-shares, this reversal regime dominates up to 20-40 trading sessions. Declaring a 20-day return factor as 'positive' direction mathematically inverted the true underlying anomaly.

turn_3_adaptive_hypothesis_formulation.economic_rationale: Rather than fighting A-share market microstructure, the pipeline must embrace empirical realities: (1) harvest short-term mean-reversion via volatility-standardized reversal; (2) penalize excessive speculative liquidity via the turnover anomaly; (3) anchor selection to fundamental cash generation via Earnings-to-Price (EP); and (4) purge sector rotation noise through Shenwan L1 industry demeaning.
